stemMd: Using molar mass 18 g/mol, how many moles of water are in 45 g?
explanationMd: Amount in moles equals mass divided by molar mass: 45/18 = 2.5. Units cancel as grams divided by grams per mole.

distractorRationale.c: Molar mass is not the amount of substance.
distractorRationale.d: Grams and moles are not numerically interchangeable.
distractorRationale.e: This multiplies mass by molar mass instead of dividing.
